question: For every tissue in the consensus RNA data, give the number of tissue enriched genes, the share of them secreted to blood, and the share that are FDA approved drug targets. Draw a bar chart of the twenty tissues with the most enriched genes and a heatmap of the ten tissues with the most enriched genes against the eight most common protein classes among their enriched genes. Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\", \"Secretome location\", \"Protein class\", \"Disease involvement\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT \"Gene\" gene,\"Gene name\" gene_name,\"Tissue\" tissue,TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) v FROM rna_tissue_consensus), y AS (SELECT a.*, MAX(b.v) othermax FROM x a JOIN x b ON b.gene=a.gene AND b.tissue<>a.tissue GROUP BY ALL), e AS (SELECT gene,gene_name,tissue FROM y WHERE v>=1 AND v>=5*COALESCE(othermax,0)), p AS (SELECT \"Gene\" gene,\"Secretome location\" sec,\"Protein class\" pc FROM proteinatlas), z AS (SELECT e.tissue,e.gene,COALESCE(p.sec,'') sec,COALESCE(p.pc,'') pc FROM e LEFT JOIN p USING(gene)) SELECT tissue,COUNT(DISTINCT gene) enriched,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sec='Secreted to blood' THEN gene END) blood_n,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sec='Secreted to blood' THEN gene END)/COUNT(DISTINCT gene),2) blood_share,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN contains(pc,'FDA approved drug targets') THEN gene END) fda_n,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN contains(pc,'FDA approved drug targets') THEN gene END)/COUNT(DISTINCT gene),2) fda_share FROM z GROUP BY tissue ORDER BY enriched DESC"}

cancer_cancers (0.0 MB): Cancer, Organ
